WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'),
dup AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT min(w.sale_date), max(w.sale_date), count(*) AS rows_in_dup, count(DISTINCT w.sales_line_id) AS ids,
 count(DISTINCT w.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(w.etl_loaded_at), max(w.etl_loaded_at),
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS member_rows,

calls.statement:
WITH active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
      AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period, coalesce(m.tier,'(no version on as-of)') AS tier, count(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to
